Sentence (English): I moved from a house to a condo on August 4, where I found a Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): I moved from a house to a condo on August 4, where I found a Bosch dishwasher. It was complicated to operate so I replaced it with a Whirlpool, which I had purchased in the house. I found that it has been modified in ways that represent a downgrade from the older version I had in the house. (1) The controls are now located farther back, and somewhat hidden vs the earlier version that displayed them prominently. (2) The wire racks on top is located too close to the component above it causing stacked small plates to roll off to the side. (3) The bottom wire rack is configured such that there is insufficient room for medium size baking dishes. In short, the reconfiguration of the wire racks will accept fewer items that the earlier version. I much prefer the older model.

Comments (English): [ This is a 6-person dishwasher with excellent cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || The delivery person installed it neatly, so I was able to use it right away. At the end of the wash cycle, the door opens slightly to evaporate moisture from the inside, which is a nice convenience. Noise is also a minor concern. I don't mind running it at night, and it seems to use much less water than washing dishes by hand. Using this reduces the stress of washing dishes, making my day much easier. Overall, I'm satisfied with this product in terms of design, cleaning power, noise reduction, and convenience. It's perfect for small kitchens and can easily accommodate families, making it a kitchen essential. I'm so happy I finally got it!
Comments (Original): [ 세척력 짱짱한 6인용 식기세척기예요 ] || ---------------- || 배송 기사님이 설치까지 깔끔하게 해주셔서 바로 쓸 수 있었어요. 생각보다 크기가 적당해서 주방에 두기 부담 없고, 디자인도 화이트라 깔끔하게 잘 어울리더라구요. 전면에 블랙 패널 들어가 있어서 은근 세련된 포인트도 있고요.  조작 버튼이 위에 있어서 사용하기도 편했어요. 처음에는 조금 낯설었는데 몇 번 눌러보니 금방 익숙해졌고, 세척 모드도 다양하게 있어서 상황에 맞게 고를 수 있었어요. 강력세척, 에코모드, 빠른세척 등등 있는데, 저는 보통 기본 세척으로도 충분하더라구요~  무엇보다 6인용이라 수납이 꽤 넉넉해요. 접시, 밥그릇, 컵, 젓가락, 심지어 냄비까지 넣어봤는데 잘 들어가고 세척도 깔끔하게 됐어요. 바스켓이 움직여서 그릇 배치하기도 수월했고, 한 번 돌릴 때마다 주방이 싹 정리되는 기분이에요.  세척력은 진짜 만족스러웠어요. 기름 묻은 접시도 반짝반짝하게 나오고, 건조 기능 덕분에 물자국 거의 없이 바로 정리 가능했어요. 세척 끝날 때 문이 살짝 열리면서 내부 습기 날려주는 기능이 있는데, 이게 은근 편리해요.  소음도 큰 걱정 안 해도 될 정도예요. 밤에 돌려도 크게 신경 안 쓰이고, 물 사용량도 손 설거지할 때보다 훨씬 적은 것 같아요. 이거 쓰면서 설거지 스트레스가 줄어드니 하루가 훨씬 편해졌어요ㅎㅎ  전반적으로 디자인, 세척력, 소음, 편리함 모두 다 만족스러운 제품이에요. 작은 주방에도 잘 맞고, 가족 단위도 충분히 커버돼서 주방 필수템 느낌이에요. 진짜 “왜 이제야 들였나” 싶을 정도로 잘 쓰고 있어요~

Sentence (English): So far I am very happy with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Does an excellent job but one minor design flaw ] || ---------------- || So far I am very happy with this dishwasher. We replaced an old Bosch (which I hated with a passion) and this one has been a pleasant surprise. The third rack on top saves up a LOT of space for the bigger dishes that go on the lower two racks so we can get a lot more dishes in. The cycle options are good; we've tried all of them and found that for average loads the "quick cycle" is all you need. The heating element can be turned on or off depending on your preferences (I like it turned off because after the cycle while it is still steamy inside you can shake off the remaining water, leave the door open, and the dishes will air dry in just a few minutes). My only gripe is that there is no indicator on the outside of the washer that tells you when the cycle is over. When you set a load to run it gives you an estimated run time but it can take longer if the sensor thinks the water is still too dirty. So I have to open the door to see how much time is left and then push a button and quickly close the door to let it finish. For example, on the "quick" cycle it says it will take 1:07, but it can go as long as 1:20. Otherwise, I love the machine.

Sentence (English): We bought this dishwasher (along with 3 other Cafe appliances) several years ago.
Comments (English): [ In all honesty, make a different choice. ] || ---------------- || We bought this dishwasher (along with 3 other Cafe appliances) several years ago. The dishwasher is by far the worst, and I don't recommend buying this at all. The excellent things are: quietness and external look. The VERY bad things are: actual cleaning performance and reliability. We have always had to use the maximum-clean “pots” setting (+high temp wash) to get close to the performance of past dishwashers. Even with that, we've had to learn where certain kinds of dishes could go to get clean and where to avoid unless the dishwasher was only minimally dirty. The drying cycle stopped working nearly a year ago (producing a relentless beeping error, causing us to just stop using the drying cycle at all). The door hinge-spring/cord mechanism snapped, causing the heavy door to fall on the floor, denting the bottom corners of the front of the machine. And, now we're getting a “PTD” error, meaning the machine won't drain (or doesn't think it's drained), and it's hard to justify hundreds of dollars of repairs for (what are likely) control board issues + perhaps a drain motor replacement. I simply fear that regular use (since they'd just be returning this machine to normal) would lead to the same timeline of disappointment. I strongly advise against picking this brand. If you're going to spend this kind of money, get a Bosch (or take your chances with something different). I wish we had done so.

Sentence (English): We recently got a dishwasher, a must-have appliance these days.
Comments (English): [ Best value dishwasher. No need to buy an expensive one. ] || ---------------- || We recently got a dishwasher, a must-have appliance these days. We already have so many things in our kitchen that it's hard to organize, and we knew a built-in dishwasher wouldn't be feasible without a new sink, so we hadn't even considered it, even though we were disappointed. But these days, there are dishwashers that sit right on top of the sink, like this one. It's called Mydiar. It used to be called Media, but I guess it's been renamed Mydiar? The top-loading washing machine we use as a side dish is from this brand. Oh, and our electric oven is also from this brand. It's such a great value, so I was really looking forward to getting a dishwasher. We postponed the installation because we needed to tidy up the kitchen a bit. When you order, you can choose an installation date, but the pre-inspection team contacted us the day before. We asked if they could come the next day, what our kitchen environment was like, and whether we needed to drill holes. We ended the call with a few suggestions. The technician contacted us that morning and arrived at the appointed time in the afternoon to complete the installation. I think the installation took about 30 minutes. When I placed it on the sink, it was surprisingly larger than I expected. With this substantial dishwasher sitting on top of the sink, it's now a reliable machine that'll handle all my dishes. I drilled a hole in the very corner of the sink for the water hose. I simply connected the drain hose to the sink. Pressing the power button for about two seconds turns the screen on. The intuitive buttons for selecting the mode—Auto, Normal, Intensive, High-Temperature Wash, and Rapid—and for things like enabling the auto door open feature and the drying function are all right there, making it easy to use. It's said to be able to wash six servings of dishes at once, so the interior is surprisingly spacious. This is the ultimate home appliance. And it can even be controlled via a smartphone app. It's truly a true value-for-money machine. Having one of these dishwashers in a rented or single-family home would be a fantastic addition. Moving the unit around in the future, as long as you're careful with the hoses at the back, shouldn't be a problem. These days, home appliances come with so many features, but I think they're really great if you just get the basics right. Simply wash your leftover dishes in the sink, then pop them in and press the button. The dishwasher will clean them clean, and the door will open. It's truly a world of convenience. Sentence (English): I've experienced a complete and total failure of the appliance and support team with GE.
Comments (English): [ I'm Stunned by the Positive Reviews ] || ---------------- || I've experienced a complete and total failure of the appliance and support team with GE. This purchase was nearly $1,000 in costs after delivery and install. The internal silicone seal failed within 6 months of purchasing. The seal failure allowed steam into the control panel housing, and shorted the control panel. The machine began beeping and chirping in the middle of the night. The washer was cycling through settings on its own, and could not be interupted without the plug being pulled. I tried to run an empty cycle in the morning and the control panel was not responding. I opened a case with the manufacturer and a repairman was dispatched rather quickly to replace the control panel and repair the silicone sealent. I was satisfied until the same issue arose again within a month of the initial repair. I called the manufacturer, reopened the case, scheduled another service call, received another control panel, and had another repair to the seal. I can say, with no exaggeration, this process repeated every 2-6 weeks for the next year. We've had 8 service calls for this single appliance. The manufacturer's solution is essentially gluing a $700 appliance together for the last year. Our repairman held a conversation with a representative at GE on speakerphone in my dining room and stated he belived this machine was a lemon and needed to be replaced. The representative pivoted to resealing the seam at every turn. The manufacturer did not change their stance after multiple phone calls and numerous service calls. The most recent repair was completed 4 weeks ago. More silicone. The control panel started flashing and beeping while running through all of the cycle options in a continuous loop once again, unable to be interupted unless i pulled the plug.The message we are now receiving is 'This machine is now out of warranty', leaving the responsibility of repairing and replacing parts to the repairman. GE has refused to offer any additional support, other than sending new tubes of silicone. The service bulletin updates have simply been to apply a different type of silicone to the same seam where the seal has failed multiple times. Inconvenient, but more understandably, Home Depot refused to replace it as well; their policy is to replace damaged appliances if reported within 48 hours. Additionally, my 2 year old GE refrigerator just failed last week. The same repairman took care of the fix, but the timing is funny enough to be worthy of mention. Simply stated, I was eager to purchase a GE instrument based on the reliability of the appliances I've owned previously. The poor experience with 'Customer Support' and the complete mechanical failure of the machine itself have put me off the brand entirely. I can't see myself ever spending another dollar on GE appliances.

We recently purchased a dishwasher, which is considered a must-have appliance these days. We already have so many things that it's difficult to organize the kitchen, and we knew that a built-in dishwasher wouldn't be feasible without a new sink, so we hadn't even considered it, even though we were disappointed. But these days, there are dishwashers that can be placed directly on the sink, like this one. The brand is called Mydia. It used to be called Media, but I guess it's been renamed Mydia at some point? The top-loading washing machine we use as a secondary dishwasher is from this brand. Oh, and our electric oven is also from this brand. It's such a great value, so I was really looking forward to the dishwasher. We postponed the installation because we needed to organize the kitchen a bit. When ordering, you can choose an installation date, but the pre-inspection team contacted us the day before. I ended the call by asking about my kitchen environment, whether I could visit the next day, and whether drilling was necessary. The technician contacted me the morning of the scheduled visit and arrived at the appointed time in the afternoon to install the dishwasher. The installation took about 30 minutes. It's surprisingly larger than I expected when placed on the sink. With this substantial dishwasher sitting on top of the sink, it's a reliable machine that'll now handle all my dishes. I drilled a hole in the corner of the sink for the water hose. I simply connected the drain hose to the sink. Press and hold the power button for about two seconds, and the screen lights up. You can choose between Auto, Standard, Powerful, High-Temperature Wash, and Rapid. The buttons for the auto door open feature and the drying feature are intuitively visible, making it easy to use. It's said to be able to wash dishes for up to six people at once, so the interior is surprisingly spacious. This is the ultimate home appliance. It can also be operated via a smartphone app. This dishwasher is truly the king of value. It would be wonderful to have one of these in a rented or studio apartment. Moving it around in the future shouldn't be a problem, as long as you're careful with the hose at the back. These days, many home appliances come with so many features, but I think it's a great product if you just get the basics right. Simply rinse the leftover dishes in the sink, then place them in the sink, press the start button, and the dishwasher will be clean and ready to go. The door opens with a snap. It's truly a breeze. If you haven't purchased a dishwasher yet because of the high price, you should definitely consider this one. Value for money is crucial when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to anyone I know. This is my honest review of what I personally experienced. I hope it's helpful to others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

We recently purchased a dishwasher, which is considered a must-have appliance these days. We already have so many things that it's difficult to organize the kitchen, and we knew that a built-in dishwasher wouldn't be feasible without a new sink, so we hadn't even considered it, even though we were disappointed. It can also be operated via a smartphone app. This dishwasher is truly the king of value. It would be wonderful to have one of these in a rented or studio apartment. Moving it around in the future shouldn't be a problem, as long as you're careful with the hose at the back. These days, many home appliances come with so many features, but I think it's a great product if you just get the basics right. If you haven't purchased a dishwasher yet because of the high price, you should definitely consider this one. Value for money is crucial when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to anyone I know. This is my honest review of what I personally experienced. I hope it's helpful to others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

A dishwasher is considered a must-have appliance these days. We recently purchased one. These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. Those who haven't bought a dishwasher yet because of the high price should really consider this product. Cost-effectiveness is really important when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

A dishwasher is considered a must-have appliance these days. We recently purchased one. We already have so many things, it's hard to organize the kitchen, and unless you're rebuilding the sink, a built-in dishwasher is a challenge. So, although I was disappointed, I hadn't even considered it. But these days, there are dishwashers that can be placed on top of the sink. Like this one. The brand used to be called Media, but I wonder when it changed to Mydia. The top-loading washing machine we use as a sub-unit is from this brand. Oh, and our electric oven is also from this brand. It's such a great value, so I was really looking forward to getting a dishwasher. I postponed the installation because I needed to organize the kitchen a bit. When ordering, you can choose an on-site installation date, but the pre-inspection team contacted me the day before. They asked if I could visit the next day, what my kitchen environment was like, and whether drilling holes were necessary. We ended the call with a few suggestions. The technician contacted me the morning of the visit, and arrived at the appointed time in the afternoon to install it. I think the installation took about 30 minutes. It's surprisingly larger than I expected when placed on the sink. With this large dishwasher sitting on top of the sink, it's a reliable machine that will now handle all my dishes. I drilled a hole in the far corner of the sink for the water hose. I simply connected the drain hose to the sink. Press and hold the power button for about two seconds, and the screen lights up. You can choose between Auto, Normal, Powerful, High-Temperature Wash, and Rapid. You can also choose whether to use the auto door open feature or the drying function. The buttons are intuitively visible, making it easy to use. It can wash dishes for up to six people at once, and the interior space is surprisingly spacious. This is the ultimate home appliance. It can even be controlled via a smartphone app. It's truly the ultimate value-for-money machine. Having a dishwasher like this in a rented or single-family home is a dream. This looks great. If you're careful about moving the product, as long as you're careful with the hose at the back, it shouldn't be too difficult. These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. First, after you wash the leftover dishes in the sink, just put them in and press the start button. It washes them clean, and the door opens right away. It's so convenient. Those who haven't bought a dishwasher yet because of the high price should really consider this product. Cost-effectiveness is really important when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

A dishwasher is considered a must-have appliance these days. We recently purchased one. We already have so many things, it's hard to organize the kitchen, and unless you're rebuilding the sink, a built-in dishwasher is a challenge. So, although I was disappointed, I hadn't even considered it. But these days, there are dishwashers that can be placed on top of the sink. Like this one. The brand used to be called Media, but I wonder when it changed to Mydia. The top-loading washing machine we use as a sub-unit is from this brand. Oh, and our electric oven is also from this brand. It's such a great value, so I was really looking forward to getting a dishwasher. I postponed the installation because I needed to organize the kitchen a bit. When ordering, you can choose an on-site installation date, but the pre-inspection team contacted me the day before. They asked if I could visit the next day, what my kitchen environment was like, and whether drilling holes were necessary. We ended the call with a few suggestions. The technician contacted me the morning of the visit, and arrived at the appointed time in the afternoon to install it. I think the installation took about 30 minutes. It's surprisingly larger than I expected when placed on the sink. With this large dishwasher sitting on top of the sink, it's a reliable machine that will now handle all my dishes. I drilled a hole in the far corner of the sink for the water hose. I simply connected the drain hose to the sink. Press and hold the power button for about two seconds, and the screen lights up. You can choose between Auto, Normal, Powerful, High-Temperature Wash, and Rapid. You can also choose whether to use the auto door open feature or the drying function. The buttons are intuitively visible, making it easy to use. It can wash dishes for up to six people at once, and the interior space is surprisingly spacious. This is the ultimate home appliance. It can even be controlled via a smartphone app. It's truly the ultimate value-for-money machine. Having a dishwasher like this in a rented or single-family home is a dream. This looks great. If you're careful about moving the product, as long as you're careful with the hose at the back, it shouldn't be too difficult. These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. First, after you wash the leftover dishes in the sink, just put them in and press the start button. It washes them clean, and the door opens right away. It's so convenient. Those who haven't bought a dishwasher yet because of the high price should really consider this product. Cost-effectiveness is really important when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비 최고 식기세척기 굳이 비싼게 필요없네요 ] || ---------------- || 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료 제공받아 작성한 리뷰입니다.요즘 필수가전이라는 식기세척기 저희도 이번에 들였어요. 살림살이가 이미 너무 많아서 주방 정리하기도 힘들고 싱크대를 새로 짜는게 아니라면 빌트인은 힘든걸 알고 있었기에 식기세척기는 아쉬워도 생각도 하지 않고 있었어요.근데 요즘은 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 그냥 올려두고 사용하는 제품들도 있더라구요. 바로 이 제품처럼요.마이디어라는 브랜드 예전에는 미디어라고 불렀는데 언젠가부터 마이디어로 바꼈네요? 저희집에 서브로 사용하는 통돌이 세탁기도 이 브랜드 제품이거든요.아참, 전기오븐도 이 브랜드꺼네요. 가성비가 참 좋은 제품이라 식기세척기도 너무 기대가 되었어요.주방을 좀 정리해야 해서 설치 일정을 미뤘어요.주문할 때 방문설치일을 선택할 수 있는데 방문일 전날 사전조사팀에서 연락이 왔어요. 내일 방문해도 되는지 주방환경이 어떤지 타공여부에 대해 물어보고 몇가지 알려주면서 통화를 마쳤어요.방문 당일 오전에 방문할 기사님이 연락이 왔고 오후 정해진 시간에 딱 맞춰서 방문하여 설치해주셨어요.설치 시간은 약 30분정도 걸린 것 같네요.싱크대에 올리니 생각보다 사이즈가 꽤 크네요.큼지막한 사이즈의 식기세척기가 싱크대 위에 올라가있으니 이제 우리집 설거지를 맡아서 해줄 든든한 녀석이란 말이죠.싱크대 가장 구석에 급수 호스가 올라올 구멍을 뚫었어요.배수호스는 그냥 싱크대로 연결하여 설치했답니다.전원버튼을 꾹 한 2초정도 누르면 화면에 불이 쭉 들어와요.자동, 표준, 강력, 고온세척, 급속 이렇게 모드를 선택하고 자동문열림 기능을 사용할지 건조기능을 설정할지 필요한 버튼들이 직관적으로 바로 보여서 사용하기 편하겠어요.무려 6인용의 식기가 한번에 설거지 가능하다고 하니 내부 공간이 생각보다 엄청 넉넉하더라구요.이게 또 가전제품의 끝판왕.. 스마트폰 앱 연동하여 작동할 수 있다고 하니.. 정말 그야말고 가성비대마왕.월세나 자취방에 이런 식기세척기 하나 놔두고 사용하면 너무 좋을 것 같네요. 추후 제품을 이동하거나 옮길 때도 뒷부분의 호스만 조심하면 크게 어려움은 없을 것 같아요.요즘 출시되는 가전제품은 참 여러 기능이 많이 들어있는데 딱 기본만 잘해도 정말 괜찮은 제품이라고 생각해요. 일단 밥 먹고 남은 그릇을 간단하게 싱크대에서 애벌하고 나서 툭툭 넣고 작동버튼만 누르면 깨끗하게 씻어서 문이 딱 열리니 세상 참 편해졌다 정말..!!높은 금액에 부담스러워 식기세척기를 아직 구매하지 못한 분들은 이 제품 정말 고민해봐야 합니다. 가전제품은 정말 가성비가 중요하거든요. 주변 지인에게도 이 제품 추천해줄래요.제가 직접 사용해보고 느낀점을 솔직하게 작성한 후기입니다.제 후기가 다른 분들에게 도움이 되었으면 좋겠습니다.후기를 읽어주셔서 감사합니다.

A dishwasher is considered a must-have appliance these days. We recently purchased one. We already have so many things, it's hard to organize the kitchen, and unless you're rebuilding the sink, a built-in dishwasher is a challenge. So, although I was disappointed, I hadn't even considered it. But these days, there are dishwashers that can be placed on top of the sink. Like this one. The brand used to be called Media, but I wonder when it changed to Mydia. The top-loading washing machine we use as a sub-unit is from this brand. Oh, and our electric oven is also from this brand. It's such a great value, so I was really looking forward to getting a dishwasher. I postponed the installation because I needed to organize the kitchen a bit. When ordering, you can choose an on-site installation date, but the pre-inspection team contacted me the day before. They asked if I could visit the next day, what my kitchen environment was like, and whether drilling holes were necessary. We ended the call with a few suggestions. The technician contacted me the morning of the visit, and arrived at the appointed time in the afternoon to install it. I think the installation took about 30 minutes. It's surprisingly larger than I expected when placed on the sink. With this large dishwasher sitting on top of the sink, it's a reliable machine that will now handle all my dishes. I drilled a hole in the far corner of the sink for the water hose. I simply connected the drain hose to the sink. Press and hold the power button for about two seconds, and the screen lights up. The buttons are intuitively visible, making it easy to use. It can wash dishes for up to six people at once, and the interior space is surprisingly spacious. This is the ultimate home appliance. It can even be controlled via a smartphone app. It's truly the ultimate value-for-money machine. Having a dishwasher like this in a rented or single-family home is a dream. This looks great. If you're careful about moving the product, as long as you're careful with the hose at the back, it shouldn't be too difficult. These days, many home appliances come with a variety of features, but I think it's a really good product if you just get the basics right. First, after you wash the leftover dishes in the sink, just put them in and press the start button. It washes them clean, and the door opens right away. It's so convenient. Those who haven't bought a dishwasher yet because of the high price should really consider this product. Cost-effectiveness is really important when it comes to home appliances. I'd recommend this product to people around me. This is my honest review based on my personal experience using it. I hope it helps others. Thank you for reading.

Sentence (English): I've experienced a complete and total failure of the appliance and support team with GE.
Comments (English): [ I'm Stunned by the Positive Reviews ] || ---------------- || I've experienced a complete and total failure of the appliance and support team with GE. This purchase was nearly $1,000 in costs after delivery and install. The internal silicone seal failed within 6 months of purchasing. The seal failure allowed steam into the control panel housing, and shorted the control panel. The machine began beeping and chirping in the middle of the night. The washer was cycling through settings on its own, and could not be interupted without the plug being pulled. I tried to run an empty cycle in the morning and the control panel was not responding. I opened a case with the manufacturer and a repairman was dispatched rather quickly to replace the control panel and repair the silicone sealent. I was satisfied until the same issue arose again within a month of the initial repair. I called the manufacturer, reopened the case, scheduled another service call, received another control panel, and had another repair to the seal. I can say, with no exaggeration, this process repeated every 2-6 weeks for the next year. We've had 8 service calls for this single appliance. The manufacturer's solution is essentially gluing a $700 appliance together for the last year. Our repairman held a conversation with a representative at GE on speakerphone in my dining room and stated he belived this machine was a lemon and needed to be replaced. The representative pivoted to resealing the seam at every turn. The manufacturer did not change their stance after multiple phone calls and numerous service calls. The most recent repair was completed 4 weeks ago. More silicone. The control panel started flashing and beeping while running through all of the cycle options in a continuous loop once again, unable to be interupted unless i pulled the plug. The message we are now receiving is 'This machine is now out of warranty', leaving the responsibility of repairing and replacing parts to the repairman. GE has refused to offer any additional support, other than sending new tubes of silicone. The service bulletin updates have simply been to apply a different type of silicone to the same seam where the seal has failed multiple times. Inconvenient, but more understandably, Home Depot refused to replace it as well; their policy is to replace damaged appliances if reported within 48 hours. Additionally, my 2 year old GE refrigerator just failed last week. The same repairman took care of the fix, but the timing is funny enough to be worthy of mention. Simply stated, I was eager to purchase a GE instrument based on the reliability of the appliances I've owned previously. The poor experience with 'Customer Support' and the complete mechanical failure of the machine itself have put me off the brand entirely. I can't see myself ever spending another dollar on GE appliances.

Sentence (English): I'm just a single guy.
Comments (English): [ I am so far VERY Happy! ] || ---------------- || I'm just a single guy. My research showed this $1700 dishwasher's build quality (Bosch 800 series) was overall the most reliable. I don't want to deal with things breaking so that's VERY important to me. It was very expensive, but I'm a buy once cry once guy, but I expect it to function perfectly also. and it does.The layout of the racks is WAY better than the 12-15 year old one I had. Amazingly, the top rack does a great job with silverware, allowing me to remove the silverware thing from the bottom rack. The second rack you can drop down the sides of the rack, which I did and these very tall 24oz glasses I prefer fit! Leaving the bottom rack for plates and big things, etc.I generally have reasonably clean dishes that go in, so I use the most efficient cycle "Normal". On my old I used no heat drying and just wiped dry what was left of the water. on this machine it must seal better or something because the dishes were wetter. Anyway, that's not a "problem" as I turned the drying off, but then I tried the crystal drying (or whatever the name is) and it works amazingly well so that's what I'll be doing from now on.I didn't care too much about quiet because my house is very old and my kitchen is absolute trash, and I have a window air conditioner, etc, noise isn't a problem. Having said that my kitchen needs to be gutted and remodeled, badly. The dishwasher wouldn't quite fit all the way under the crappy countertop and it sticks out at least 3" farther then it should. Also, the sides of the cabinets aren't really cabinet sides and are super thin (not more than 1/4") on both sides of the dishwasher. AND on one side this thin barrier is between the two doors directly under the sink, which are no longer there, because my cabinets are trash, lol, so my point is I have far less noise dampening around my dishwasher then you. And I still can't hear it almost at all standing right next to it, lol.I can't even tell it's on if not for the red light! This has been measured at 42dB buy reviewers. anything claiming to be quieter is irrelevant, unless you are sleeping right next to the dishwasher, lol.Finally, the LAST thing I want is everything in my house connected to the Internet so the CCP can hack my home network, lol. I do NOT want things like this connected to the Internet! I was able to disable the wireless and in doing so I discovered it was already off by turning it on, so I had to look up how to turn it back off, which was just do a reset. I hate messing with new things, I'm in IT and it's exhausting, lol, but I always download the manual and have it handy, so I have a system, and this was no big deal.But one reviewer pointed out there are features you cannot use without it being online. I'm not going to be using them anyway, but this kind of sucks. You should be able to control your machine without it going out to the Internet. This isn't a Bosch issue, it's ALL manufacturers.Aside from the that I am very pleased with my purchase, and I can recommend this with zero hesitation.

Comments (English): [ An Amazing Dishwasher for a Great Price ] || ---------------- || I recently bought a Bosch 500 series dishwasher, and it is fantastic. The dishwasher's Home Connect feature connects to Alexa, allowing you to use voice commands to start a cycle. I set up a simple command, "Alexa, turn on Bosch” and now I can start the dishwasher with my voice. It may sound excessive, but it is a great convenience. The app also tracks power and water use, which is a nice reward. When it comes to cleaning, this dishwasher leaves everything spotless. My biggest tip? Use rinse aid. The pop-open door feature is great and works only if you turn it on. The filter is also incredibly easy to clean; it is simple to remove and wash. Another convenient feature is the single utensil basket. You might think one is not enough, but it saves valuable space, and I have found that it is all you need. The Bosch 500 series have more space than I am used to, due to the third rack for utensils and small plastic items. It is a subtle but stately design choice that makes a significant difference. The Bosch 500 series is a fantastic dishwasher for the price. It is quiet, beautiful, and leaves dishes spotless.

Your dishes will taste like the darn soap. Especially if you have stainless Steele products. My food tasted like the soap for days. I tried bar keepers, vinegar, baking soda, you name it. Took weeks. I switched to cascade and it works well. No more weird soapy taste. Ironically, cascade didn't work well on my last Dishwasher but Finish did. I never noticed this on other dishwashers so it could be the normal but the heavy cycle option takes 30 minutes less than the normal cycle. Maybe this is normal idk. Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for about a week now, and overall, I'm very satisfied with its performance.
Comments (English): [ Great dishwasher with tons of features ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for about a week now, and overall, I'm very satisfied with its performance. It cleans exceptionally well — dishes come out spotless and completely free of residue. One feature I really appreciate is the smudge-proof finish, which keeps it looking clean and modern. The top-mounted controls also give it a sleek, streamlined appearance.I prefer my appliances to have a consistent look, and this model blends well with others since the logo is discreetly placed on the top strip under the counter — barely visible. The third rack doesn't hold much, but it's perfect for small items like drink lids and utensils.That said, while it's marketed as a quiet dishwasher, it's actually the loudest one I've owned. The noise level caught me off guard at first — I even double-checked the model to be sure it was correct. Over time I've gotten used to it, but it's worth noting if you're expecting near-silent operation.Also, be aware that this dishwasher mounts only under the counter. If you have a stone countertop, you'll need a separate mounting kit. Ours was supposed to come with installation, but the installer didn't have it on hand and had to return a week later to finish the job.Despite these small hiccups, I'm happy with the purchase and would recommend it with a few caveats.

Comments (English): [ Bosch 800 series ] || ---------------- || I love this dishwasher because it's probably the best drying dishwasher on the market. However, I do long for the days of old when it had a heating element because I do believe the dishes were their driest then. The dishes come out really clean. I do think some of them retain some scratches sometimes, and I wish there was an option for a shorter cycle that included crystal dry. Also not a fan of the slanted racks - this is one thing Miele does better. I would prefer the control panel was on the front, that there was a light on the 800 model, and that there was an option for a salt dispenser on the 800 model as well. I'm pleased with it overall, and I'd buy another one, I do hope Bosch acknowledges these suggestions for future products though. Overall, still a fantastic dishwasher.

Sentence (English): Got this a little over a week ago, and so far am happy with it.
Comments (English): [ Very nice dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Got this a little over a week ago, and so far am happy with it. It is very quiet, it gets the dishes clean, and it also gets them dry. (Big difference in the drying, by the way, from using the Rinse Aid product.) I like having the third, top rack for awkward utensils that are either long or plastic (like an ice cream scoop). I don't like, or perhaps am just not yet used to, the greater width of spacing on the main racks. It accommodates large bowls and pots nicely, but in comparison with my previous Kitchenaid dishwasher (bought in 2017) I don't seem to utilize the space as well--even though this model is actually deeper and so more spacious. Plates lean in more deeply than previously, so space is sacrificed that might have accommodated other objects, such as small bowls or cups. I'm still getting the hang of where to position things, though, and this is not a big deal to me.

Sentence (English): Okay, full disclosure, I got a free dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ in LOVE ] || ---------------- || Okay, full disclosure, I got a free dishwasher. I went from a samsung (in one of the photos) to this Whirlpool/Kitchenaid and let me tell you, oh boy, did I upgrade. This dishwasher has a third rack for utensils—a game changer for saving room. No longer am I laying wooden spoons down where I should have room for bowls. I cannot emphasize how clean my dishes came out. Even the crappy plastic tupperware was spotless. The controls are in the front, and as it runs, it shows you what part of the process you're in. I ended up installing the dishwasher with my dad, and it wasn't too bad. The directions could have been a little clearer, but when isn't that the case. We hooked up the drain line, electric, and water, pushed her in, and didn't run into any issues. There's a drain tray in the front that blocks the electric but it can be accessed from the front. All in all it took about 2 and a half hours for average joes to install and it runs like a dream. Thank you whirlpool for giving me the cleanest dishes of my life!

Sentence (English): I am beyond disappointed with this dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Very disappointed. Avoid purchasing. ] || ---------------- || I am beyond disappointed with this dishwasher. With normal household use the fascia of this dishwasher has cracked four times within a year. They have agreed to swap this model out for the exact same model out of "Goodwill" but have told me that if the fascia cracks again we are on our own. For a dishwasher that is ONE YEAR OLD this is absolutely is ridiculous. If it cracks again I believe there is definitely a fault with this dishwasher and to me it is not fit for purpose under the consumer guarantees act. I emailed back asking if I could change the replacement to one where the buttons are on the outside instead of the inside and the response was "No" even though I said I was happy to pay additional costs as it would save me time having to apply for leave every time it needed to be replaced. Below are the suggestions that Bosch have given for cracks appearing days after it was repaired and my response to them: Bosch: Moisture Damage: Excessive moisture or water exposure can damage the fascia and lead to deterioration over time. My response: The cracks appearing in the fascia appeared within a week or less of it being replaced. I do not think that it is reasonable as a consumer to expect that the fascia would crack due to excessive moisture or water exposure leading to deterioration over time when the dishwasher is used once a day and we do not have any leakage issues in our kitchen. Bosch: Installation Issues: If the dishwasher is not installed properly, it may not align correctly, causing stress on the panel. My reponse:The cabinetry has a dedicated space for the dishwasher so no stress is placed on the panel. There is more than a cm gap around the dishwasher so no pressure is placed on the dishwasher panels. Bosch: Harsh Cleaning Products: Using harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning materials on the panel can damage its surface, potentially leading to cracks. My response: We generally use a microfibre cloth and water so no chemicals are used. Bosch: Improper Use: Forcibly opening or closing the door can cause damage, especially if the panel is pulled or twisted. My response: We open the door as we have always done. We do not yank or force the door. We have had a previous Bosch dishwasher that lasted for years and years and never had an issue. The only reason we replaced it was because it no longer heated up the water. I have been happy with Bosch Appliances until this experience. We have had dishwashers, washing machines, dryers with no issues. But this dishwasher has really left me wondering if I should purchase Bosch appliances in the future.

For a dishwasher that is ONE YEAR OLD this is absolutely is ridiculous. If it cracks again I believe there is definitely a fault with this dishwasher and to me it is not fit for purpose under the consumer guarantees act. Bosch: Installation Issues: If the dishwasher is not installed properly, it may not align correctly, causing stress on the panel. My reponse:The cabinetry has a dedicated space for the dishwasher so no stress is placed on the panel. There is more than a cm gap around the dishwasher so no pressure is placed on the dishwasher panels. Bosch: Harsh Cleaning Products: Using harsh chemicals or abrasive cleaning materials on the panel can damage its surface, potentially leading to cracks. My response: We generally use a microfibre cloth and water so no chemicals are used. Bosch: Improper Use: Forcibly opening or closing the door can cause damage, especially if the panel is pulled or twisted. My response: We open the door as we have always done. We have had dishwashers, washing machines, dryers with no issues. But this dishwasher has really left me wondering if I should purchase Bosch appliances in the future.

I always wash dishes by hand, but now that the machine does it for me, it saves time and is so much more comfortable. I feel like it's becoming more and more of a hassle, but I'm very satisfied. For a family of five, a 6-person dishwasher was just right. Aside from the bulkiness, there were no other inconveniences. When we set a delivery date in advance, it arrived early that morning. The delivery driver even texted me with the expected arrival time and called me if he was going to be a little late. I had an entire day off, so it was fine, and the driver was very friendly. And since it comes with a two-year warranty and paid after-sales service even after that, I can use it with peace of mind. Since it's for 6 people, it can hold quite a lot of dishes, and there's a cutlery holder inside. It's also convenient because it's linked to an app. Most of all, it rinses cleanly and has a drying function, so I think I'll be using it usefully in the future! This review is an honest account of my experience using the product provided by Coupang Experience Group. Just as I get help from reading reviews written by others when purchasing a product, I hope my review will be helpful to others when purchasing the product above. I wrote it as objectively and sincerely as possible. If my review was helpful, please don't forget to click the "Helpful" button below :). Thank you for reading the long review and have a great day!

Sentence (English): I almost decided not to buy a dishwasher from Costco due to all the horror stories about delivery and installation.
Comments (English): [ Delivery and Installation was stellar! ] || ---------------- || I almost decided not to buy a dishwasher from Costco due to all the horror stories about delivery and installation. I decided to chance it, although I did have my own delivery horror story involving furniture from Costco a few years ago. In the end, Costco made good on the furniture debacle, though it took months and way too many phone calls. I'm happy report that in the large market Los Angeles area, dishwasher delivery and installation turned out to be stellar. I did need to have the installer put in a new outlet, as the 30 year old Whirlpool dishwasher this was replacing was hard-wired, but I was expecting that and Costco made it very clear and I knew what to expect down to how much I would need to pay for this extra service. The installer was very professional and diligent, and did not mind that my circuit breakers were poorly marked. He figured out which one the dishwasher was on and turned it off while he did the electrical work. I had called an electrician who had done work for me before to see if he could do the work in advance, but he had told me I would first have to take the dishwasher out before he could tell me what the work would entail, and I did not want to do that. So waiting for the dishwasher to be delivered and having the installer do it all at the same time made the most sense, and I'm very happy with my decision. The installer had to leave a little gap between my counter and the top of the dishwasher, and he explained the reason to me, which made sense, and I actually like it better this way than if it was flush against the top, because it means that I can see all the controls and lights even when the dishwasher is closed and running. Delivery was a couple of hours after the window that I had been given, which obviously wasn't ideal, but after watching the installer do the work in my kitchen I knew that these things take time, sometimes more than expected, so he was forgiven.Now onto the dishwasher itself: I was sad to see my 30 year old Whirlpool go, since it lasted so long for a reason: they made things better back in those days! But it had started to leak, and it didn't make sense to repair it, so a new dishwasher was in order. I literally spent weeks reading reviews and going over my options before I decided on this dishwasher. Had I not gotten a KitchenAid I would probably have gone with a Bosch, but I had read too many bad Bosch reviews, including the New York Times Wirecutter saying they no longer recommended Bosch as the quality had gone down. I opted for this one really based on the reviews here on the Costco site, so thank you to everyone who reviewed it before me, you really helped me make this decision. And I agree with those who said before me that having a light inside is really nice. Who knew? I don't run the dishwasher every day, living in a 2 person household, and this baby holds A LOT! It is a little awkward to have to reach so far down to open the door all the way, but this is obviously why it has such a large capacity! I love the top third rack. which I mainly use for glasses and mugs, not silverware. Dishes come out clean and mostly dry, but I honestly don't mind having to use a dish towel to dry off any remaining moisture, mostly from trapped water on the tops of bowls and things. It dries much better than my old dishwasher, anyway. It is not totally quiet, you can definitely hear it running when you are in the room, but it is pretty whisper quiet, so that's fine. All in all, no complaints as yet about the dishwasher itself, and I am very happy that I did not let the horror stories stop me from getting a dishwasher at Costco.

Sentence (English): Bought this to replace my 30 yr old Kitchen Aid.
Comments (English): [ Works reasonably well but takes work on your part ] || ---------------- || Bought this to replace my 30 yr old Kitchen Aid. I have done 5 full cycles now with varying degrees of success. Does a reasonably good job washing dishes but unless you are adding extra washing time or more water you have to clean the dishes before you put them in, not merely scrape off food debris. If it cannot wash off a bit of chocolate chip from a bowl, there's a proble. Does not have great success drying even with the extra drying feature. Silverware caddy is "cute" but having to add one piece of silverware at a time is a pain. I just opened up half of the caddy.If you want it to work well you have to be really precise in how you load the dishwasher and it takes work. Machine is not very forgiving if you just put dishes in the dishwasher like most people would. It seems like the machine cannot handle any slight deviation from how the instructions tell you to load the dishwasher. If a few plates or bowls not perfectly aligned with each other and other items you're not going to get a great wash. So, yes it works reasonably well, but it's not a human friendly machine. I would spend another 100-200 dollars and get a different model.

Comments (English): [ Never Buying Whirlpool Again ] || ---------------- || Where do I even begin with this thing. When it's actually working, it does a good job. However, we've had ours for 1.5 years, and in that span of time, the pump has gone out (replaced under warranty), then the new one went out a couple weeks later (just outside warranty), but that turned out to be loose wiring from the tech that replaced the pump the first time. Easy for me to fix once I identified the issue. A month later, the heating element went out, so the replacement cost was on us. That brings us to today, where I believe the pump has gone out again. I've tried soft and hard resetting, resetting the control panel, checking the plugs and tubing; can't get it to run properly. We've done a vinegar cycle every month or two as recommended by the tech who replaced the pump the first time. It's dang near spotless inside, but the pump seems to have failed yet again, anyways.When I contacted Whirlpool about how disappointing this dishwasher was (after the pump acted up the second time, a week after warranty expired), they sent me a '15% off' coupon to buy a new one. Insane that they expect the average consumer to ditch their year-old dishwasher and just casually buy a new one after such a terrible experience with the first. Long story short, avoid this Whirlpool dishwasher if you can. I know we will personally never buy ANY Whirlpool product again based on the issues with this dishwasher and how "support" tried to help.

Sentence (English): This dishwasher is a MAJOR upgrade from my last one.
Comments (English): [ High end look with unique, efficient features ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is a MAJOR upgrade from my last one. My house is modern contemporary so I was excited to incorporate the black ore finish. It is so sleek and expensive looking. I like it so much more than the normal black or stainless steel. It almost looks like polished dark cement, which I love. I am obsessed. I would say the finish is fingerprint resistant. I put my hands all over it and while it mostly doesn't show most prints, it does in a few instances. I do like the hidden buttons on the top that illuminate when touched. It will take some time getting used to their location. When closing or opening the door, I tend to accidentally bump them with my thumb. The inside of the tub is all stainless steel which means it is well-built and will last a lot of use. The 3 racks inside allow for so many dishes and utensils. As a new mom that now washes many, many small bottle parts, it is very appreciated. The top rack has limited use. It can hold small or short items like flat utensils, cups or mugs. The 2nd rack is adjustable so can be moved higher or lower. It also has special hooks and rubber bumpers to hold precious wine glasses. The bottom rack has nice utensil holders that can be moved or removed. I do wish that the holes were all the large size (some are smaller) since my utensils can't fit width wise in the small holes. The dishwasher does have several really cool features. The eject/open door at the end of the cycle is one of my favorites. It pops open the door when the cycle is finished to prevent mold and air dry if you forget. The whole cycle is extremely quiet - don't even know it's on most of the time. There is a self cleaning filtration system with no maintenance which is awesome. There is a foreign object cup that protects the pump and pops up for easy removal. The pro dry cycle really dries the dishes well but it does take longer. I did have a quick cycle of 28 minutes on my old one which is a big difference to the quick cycle of 1 hr 10 minutes on this one. Overall I am very impressed with the features and quality and equally in love with the elevated look and finish.

Easy for me to fix once I identified the issue. A month later, the heating element went out, so the replacement cost was on us. That brings us to today, where I believe the pump has gone out again. Long story short, avoid this Whirlpool dishwasher if you can. I know we will personally never buy ANY Whirlpool product again based on the issues with this dishwasher and how "support" tried to help.

Sentence (English): So far, this dishwasher has been a great upgrade for our kitchen.
Comments (English): [ Excellent dishwasher option ] || ---------------- || So far, this dishwasher has been a great upgrade for our kitchen. We really like the third rack that allows you to separate smaller items such as utensils and tops and various random child cup parts and seals away from all of your larger items. We are very happy to have a stainless steel interior that makes it much easier for the machine or us to clean. The stainless exterior is a welcome change as well but it does show finger prints (especially child prints lol) badly. The one good thing is that any prints wipe off very easily with just a paper towel or rag. The top control buttons are hidden by the counter top when the door is closed and this has taken some getting used to. We have never had a dishwasher that did not have the controls on the front. Once you pick the type of cleaning cycle you want, you have a few seconds to close the door and the machine will take it from there. I do suggest making sure to read the instruction manual prior to use as the different options that the control panel gives you might be quite different from what you are used to. I suggest downloading the Smart Things app to your phone as it gives you ways to control and monitor your dishwasher remotely. I have found it helpful that the app shows exactly what the dishwasher is doing and how long it has left. The dishwasher has the feature of opening the door at the end of a full cycle as a way of helping dry your items. That is a feature to remind family members of since we found that all of us kept closing the door any time we walked by it and saw that it was open. Something to know that you will not realize until your machine arrives, is that you must purchase an installation kit separately from the machine. I had no idea that a brand new dishwasher at this price point could arrive without a power cord or drainage hoses. I had a brand new machine delivered and our old machine hauled away but no way to finish hooking up the new dishwasher or even turning it on until having to purchase an installation kit from a hardware store. That is not a lesson you want to learn after you have unhooked and removed your old dishwasher and let it be hauled off before you realize that you can't run your water back on in the kitchen since there's no way to connect the new machine without an installation kit. This is apparently supposed to be common knowledge and up to the consumer to take care of. Calling customer service to complain about this will not get you any results or any closer to making you able to turn on or connect your new dishwasher so I advise you to just go purchase a kit online or from a store prior to the delivery date. Doing this will save you from the frustration of being unable to use it until you get one. After getting a kit, downloading the app (and the full instructions manual to an iPad which was sent as a download link in the emails prior to the machine's delivery), and taking the time to read the instructions/playing with the app…the new dishwasher has been a much needed upgrade for our family. We have been using it with cleaning packs and finishing rinse product (Jet Dry type product which helps tremendously) and it has performed without any issues. It is a very quiet machine but it does makes some interesting sounds when completing a cycle. It took us a bit to figure out what was making the new beeping sounds in the house when we first used it. The dishwasher was so quiet that we didn't remember that it was even running. When it completed a load a dishes, it emits it tones to let you know and we had never heard those before. It was funny to finally realize that it was the dishwasher that we had forgotten was even running because it was so quiet. The washer is nice looking, easy to clean both the exterior and interior, keeps children/adults from touching control buttons when the door is closed, cleans the dishes well due to its StormWash function, was fairly easy to install once we had an installation kit, and is very quiet compared to most dishwashers we have ever owned or used before. We recommend this dishwasher.

Sentence (English): We recently upgraded to the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher, and it has exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience.
Comments (English): [ Best Dishwasher we have ever owned ] || ---------------- || We recently upgraded to the Bosch 500 Series Dishwasher, and it has exceeded my expectations in performance, design, and convenience. This is by far the best dishwasher we have ever owned. It was super easy to setup and can be fully programmed and monitored from my phone. The features on this Key Features & Experience: AutoAir Dry: this.is one of the greatest features I have seen on a dishwasher. At the end of the cycle, the door automatically pops open to let fresh air in, which helps dishes dry more completely—especially plastics—without leaving water spots. We can literally take everything out and put it away without any extra drying. Quiet Operation: it's so quiet that I hardly notice it's running. There is a small floor light that shines while the cycle is in progress, which is a nice touch since it really is so quiet. RackFlex System: The adjustable RackFlex design gives a lot of flexibility. The third rack on top is perfect for utensils, spatulas, and such, freeing up space in the lower racks. Performance: Dishes come out spotless, even after skipping pre-rinse. The powerful spray arms and precision wash system handle baked-on messes easily. Our first test was on an older crockpot that we were thinking of replacing. The zone wash cleaned it so well that it is now back in full service. Everything comes out looking like new. Design & Build Quality: The sleek stainless-steel interior not only looks premium but also resists stains and odors. The control panel is simple, intuitive, blends nicely, and is tucked out of site while closed. No pets or little hands simply reaching over and messing with it. Energy & Water Efficiency: It uses less water than our old dishwasher, and the Energy Star rating gives peace of mind knowing that we will be saving on utilities. Final Thoughts: The Bosch 500 Series balances quiet performance, excellent cleaning power, and smart drying technology. If you want a dishwasher that blends seamlessly into your kitchen while delivering consistent results, this model is worth every penny.

Sentence (English): The dishwasher cleans and dries well when it doesn't error out.
Comments (English): The dishwasher cleans and dries well when it doesn't error out. We've had it error out a handful of times full of times since we've gotten it, leaving water on the. Bottom and having to run it again to get the dishes clean and the water out of the bottom since there is no drain dishwasher option. I'm also still learning how to load it. Everything inside is so slanted you have to load it how Bosch wants you to load it vs what works for you as the consumer. I often find my larger glasses tip over because I can't hold them in with my coffee mugs any longer due to how slanted the inside is. Great clean, design could use some work. (But if the design is why I'm getting the clean - well I guess I have to live with the hodge podge of how my dishes have to go in)

Other times, the power would be on but nothing happens when starting a wash. Now there is no power at all. Turned off breaker for 10 minutes then back on but no life. All connections below the unit are securely in place. My guess is the control board is dead after finding many others with the same problem. I can fix it but shouldn't have to with something that is a year and a half old. These new appliances are getting bad.

Sentence (English): Bought this Bosch dishwasher in JUNE from Lowe's.
Comments (English): [ Won't work, NO customer support ] || ---------------- || Bought this Bosch dishwasher in JUNE from Lowe's. unit doesn't work, it fills then drains w/in 4 min. After 4 visits to Lowe's to see if anyone could help I was told I needed to call Bosch directly as they don't have anyone in the store that knows exactly how it works as they have over a thousand items that they sell, and sorry… you only had 48 hrs to return a defective product…Thank you Lowe's! They did say it sounds like I do have a defective product. Calling Bosch directly was a joke, the woman told me to unplug the dw then hit the reset button, then the washing setting I want. At that point she wanted to disconnect the call. that she couldn't JUST stay on the line with me that long…so I told her that I would just keep talking for the 4 minutes needed…so, she didn't hang up and while arguing that “wasn't that her job, to help me,”…the dw did what it always does. filled then drained. At that point she said she would send names of appliance centers I could call to come over and repair whatever was wrong with the dishwasher…at MY EXPENSE! Do I not have a 1 yr warranty? A friend was in the market for a dishwasher, I invited her to my home to see mine…she went with an LG. I have spent too many hours looking for help…if this review helps even 1 more person from wasting their time and money on buying a Bosch I'm good…there are other good brands to buy. In the meantime, I will continue to let people know and see what they might get.

Sentence (English): A few years ago, I remember not being very satisfied with the dishwasher that was available as an option because it didn't have an automatic door opening feature.
Comments (English): [ Satisfactory product ] || ---------------- || A few years ago, I remember not being very satisfied with the dishwasher that was available as an option because it didn't have an automatic door opening feature. That's why I didn't have a positive reaction to purchasing a dishwasher. Reason for purchase - As my baby grew, he started looking for me only, and on weekends, I ended up washing dishes for more than 30 minutes three times a day. I decided to buy it because I felt like I kept pushing away the child who came to play with me. The two things I focused on were 'cost-effectiveness' and 'automatic door opening'. After looking for a few days, I found that the price of the dishwasher varies depending on the options. The presence of lighting (internal lighting), glide rail (shelves that automatically slide out), presence of touch button, 3-tier shelf, automatic door opening, 100°C True Steam hot air drying +) You can adjust the height of the shelf with the smart shelf to load large dishes +) There is a dedicated knife/scissors holder :) They advertise that the automatic door opening releases hot air and takes time to dry, but it is clearly different from hot air drying. You can think of it as barely drying at all. In my case, I'm not the type to clean things right away, so the hot air drying feature isn't a particularly useful feature, so I took a look at this product. I happened to buy the product on sale, and I applied for a 10% refund, so the actual cost is about 80. Installation cost - The technician will call you the day before. After explaining the environment of your home and telling me where you want it installed, if they have come to the same apartment to install it, they will tell you the installation cost right away. In my house, they said that they had to open two drawers and make smaller ones, and they said it would cost 230,000 won. I postponed the installation once because I was worried about the money, but considering the cost-effectiveness + 10% refund, I think it was a good cost-effective installation. User review - If you pre-wash it, it really cleans very well. Of course, you do pre-wash it, but it only takes 5 minutes to clean up after dinner and then pre-wash it. Sometimes, there are products that don't wash properly. But other than that, I can turn a blind eye to it because they wash the dishes well (?). You don't need a hot air dryer like me. This product's energy efficiency rating has been improved from Level 3 to Level 2, reducing electricity and water usage. (While the wash time may be slightly longer, the efficiency gains are clear.) Installation was completed in about 20 minutes by two service technicians. They properly connected the power strip, organized the cables neatly, and even helped me choose the installation location, which was very satisfying. While the capacity is rated for 6 people, it actually has ample storage space, allowing for ample storage for dishes of various sizes. The noise level is also relatively quiet, which is a plus. I contacted Samsung Electronics customer service, and they explained that this feature is designed to allow for natural drying without additional hot air. Since the door opens about 5 minutes before the end to dry, the Intensive cycle seems more efficient, considering the drying effect. I use both the all-in-one powder detergent and a rinse aid. When I used only the powder detergent, water and powder marks remained despite the all-in-one design. However, with the rinse aid, the machine finished cleanly without any water marks. This might be helpful for first-time users. I haven't tried all the cycles yet, but I liked the high-temperature sterilization function and the Intensive drying mode, which extends the drying time and improves drying power. Overall, the new model and improved energy efficiency rating are the biggest advantages. It delivered satisfactory cleaning power and convenience from the first use, so I think I'll be using it often in the future. I hope this review will be helpful to others.

Sentence (English): A few years ago, I remember being dissatisfied with the dishwasher I had as an option because it didn't have an automatic door opening feature.
Comments (English): [ Satisfactory product ] || ---------------- || A few years ago, I remember being dissatisfied with the dishwasher I had as an option because it didn't have an automatic door opening feature. That's why I wasn't very positive about buying a dishwasher. Motivation for purchase: As my baby grew, he started to look for me, and on weekends, I ended up washing dishes for over 30 minutes three times a day. I felt like I was constantly pushing him away when he came to play, so I decided to buy one. My main priorities were "cost-effectiveness" and "automatic door opening." After researching for a few days, I found that dishwasher prices varied depending on the options. Options included: lighting (internal lighting), glide rails (shelves that automatically extend out), touch buttons, three-tier shelves, automatic door opening, 100°C True Steam, and hot air drying. The "smart shelf" allows you to adjust the shelf height to accommodate larger dishes. The "smart shelf" also features a dedicated knife and scissors holder. While the auto door opening advertises that it releases heat and takes time to dry, it's a distinct difference from hot air drying. I think you can consider it as almost non-drying. In my house, we don't clean right away, so hot air drying isn't a huge benefit, so I was interested in this product. I happened to purchase it on a flash sale and applied for a 10% rebate, so the actual cost is about 80,000 won. Installation cost. - The installer called the day before. After explaining your home environment and telling you where you'd like the installation, they'll tell you the installation cost if they've been to your apartment before. In my case, they said they'd have to remove two drawers and replace them with smaller ones, and they quoted me 230,000 won. I postponed the installation once because I was worried about the cost, but considering the cost-effectiveness + 10% rebate, I think it was a good value installation. User review. - The pre-washing really cleans the dishes thoroughly. Of course, I do pre-wash them, but it only takes about 5 minutes to clean up after dinner. Sometimes, some dishes don't wash properly. But other than that, I can close my eyes because it washes the dishes well (?). I don't need to use hot air drying like I do. I don't need lighting or glide rails. I don't mind if the touch buttons are exposed on the outside. Those who do that will think they made a good purchase if they choose this model. It's great because it's for 14 people :) If the size of 12 people and 14 people are the same and the price is similar, you should definitely buy the 14 people.
